name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 125 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 125 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces continue raids in occupied West West Bank villages, targeting NGOs and staff, while settlers set fire to a mosque and attacked olive harvesters. In Gaza, Israel blocked construction of a key base created by the Trump peace board and carried out air strikes that killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and rescued a girl from a burning apartment. Former Israeli security chief and an ex-Shin Bet chief have each filed defamation suits against Netanyahu over the October 7 events. Kamala Harris said President Biden should have acted to stop Israel's conduct in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker fortsetter raid i okkuperte landsbyer på Vestbredden, og retter seg mot NGO-er og ansatte, mens bosettere setter fyr på en moské og angriper olivenhøsterne. I Gaza blokkerte Israel byggingen av en viktig base opprettet av Trump-fredsutvalget og gjennomførte luftangrep som drepte en palestinsk kvinne i Gaza-by og reddet en jente fra en brennende leilighet. En tidligere israelsk sikkerhetschef og en tidligere Shin-Bet-sjef har hver for seg saksøkt Netanyahu for ærekrenkelse over hendelsene 7. oktober. Kamala Harris sa at president Biden burde ha handlet for å stoppe Israels handlinger i Gaza. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
